```{python}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
import os
os.chdir(os.path.join(os.getcwd(), ".."))   # analysis/poisson_susie_simulations -> analysis
os.chdir("..")                                # -> twogroup_experiments/
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, "analysis/poisson_susie_simulations")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
plt.rcParams["figure.dpi"] = 110
import polars as pl
import resultslib as R

pip, cs = R.load_both()                       # all 20 arms, one supercollection
elbo = R.elbo_frame()                          # per-fit common-Q2 ELBO (Q2 arms only)

# Primary comparison: the EB arms (headline). The fixed unit-prior (_pv1) twins get their
# own short section. gIBSS/CAVI x Q1/Q2 + score.
EB = ["q2_gibss", "q1_gibss", "q2_cavi", "q1_cavi", "q2_score"]
PV1 = [m + "_pv1" for m in EB]
EB = [m for m in EB if m in R.methods_present(pip)]
PV1 = [m for m in PV1 if m in R.methods_present(pip)]

SER = {"Lstar": 1, "fit_L": 1}                 # single causal, correctly-specified SER
MULTI = {"Lstar": [2, 3, 5], "fit_L": 10}      # multiple causals, over-specified L=10
```

Experiment **021** fits well-specified Poisson counts $y_i \sim \text{Poisson}(e^{b_0 + x_i\beta})$
with four approximations to the intractable Poisson-SuSiE marginal - **gIBSS** (plug-in mean
offset), **CAVI-cf** (exact closed-form offset, Gaussian effect), **CAVI-selfnorm** (exact
offset, free-form effect), **score** (null-anchored linearization) - each in a **Q1** (free-form)
and **Q2** (Gaussian) effect posterior where applicable, at fixed EB prior (this page) and a
fixed unit prior (§C). The baseline rate is $\lambda_0 = e^{b_0} \in \{0.1, 1, 10\}$; $\beta$ is
calibrated per (design, $\lambda_0$) to a target $T = \mathbb{E}[\text{LRT}] \in \{4,8,16,32\}$,
so detectability is matched and $\lambda_0$ varies only the count discreteness.

```{python}
#| label: status
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
have = ", ".join(R.METHOD_LABEL.get(m, m) for m in R.methods_present(pip))
n_reps = pip.group_by(["design_n", "lambda0", "T", "Lstar", "gap", "fit_L", "method"]).len()["len"]
print(f"**Arms present:** {have}.\n\n**Cells x method:** {n_reps.len()} groups, "
      f"{int(n_reps.median())} replicates each (median).")
```

# Part A - single-effect, SER fits {#sec-partA}

One causal, one fitted effect (`Lstar=1, fit_L=1`).

## PIP calibration {#sec-pip-cal}

Empirical causal frequency vs PIP-bin midpoint; one method per panel, rows = design, dot area
$\propto$ features in the bin. Diagonal = calibrated.

```{python}
#| label: fig-pip-cal
#| column: page
#| fig-cap: "PIP calibration, single-effect SER, pooled over the rate ladder and T within each design."
R.pip_calibration(pip, facet=["design"], filt=SER, methods=EB)
plt.show()
```

Resolved by baseline rate $\lambda_0$ (rows = design, columns within = method; one method-grid
per rate is pooled here into the rate facet):

```{python}
#| label: fig-pip-cal-rate
#| column: screen-inset

R.pip_calibration(pip, facet=["design_n", "lambda0"], filt=SER, methods=EB, panel=1.7)
plt.show()
```

# Part D - variational fit (common Q2 ELBO) {#sec-elbo}

Per-fit common-Q2 ELBO, paired on the sim; median $\Delta$ELBO of each Q2 arm vs **CAVI-cf·Q2**
(nats), per (design, $\lambda_0$). Q2 arms only (a free-form Q1 state has no Q2 ELBO).

```{python}
#| label: fig-elbo
#| column: page
#| fig-cap: "Median paired dELBO vs CAVI-cf Q2 (nats), Q2 arms, faceted by design; x = baseline rate lambda0. Points above 0 = higher ELBO than the exact CAVI-cf fold."
import numpy as np
Q2 = [m for m in ["q2_gibss", "q2_cavi", "q2_score"] if m in R.methods_present(elbo)] if not elbo.is_empty() else []
if elbo.is_empty() or not Q2:
    R._placeholder("ELBO pending (needs fits.parquet)")
else:
    d = elbo.filter(pl.col("method").is_in(Q2) & pl.col("q2_elbo").is_not_null())
    key = ["batch_hash", "rep", "fit_L"]
    ref = d.filter(pl.col("method") == "q2_cavi").select(key + ["q2_elbo"]).rename({"q2_elbo": "ref"})
    j = d.join(ref, on=key, how="inner").with_columns((pl.col("q2_elbo") - pl.col("ref")).alias("dE"))
    g = (j.group_by(["design", "design_n", "lambda0", "fit_L", "method"])
           .agg(pl.col("dE").median().alias("med")))
    designs = sorted(g["design_n"].unique().to_list())
    fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, len(designs), figsize=(3.4 * len(designs), 3.2), squeeze=False, sharey=True)
    lams = sorted([x for x in g["lambda0"].unique().to_list() if x is not None])
    for ax, dn in zip(axes[0], designs):
        gg = g.filter(pl.col("design_n") == dn)
        for m in Q2:
            for L, mk in [(1, "o"), (10, "s")]:
                s = gg.filter((pl.col("method") == m) & (pl.col("fit_L") == L)).sort("lambda0")
                if s.height:
                    ax.plot(s["lambda0"], s["med"], mk + "-", color=R.method_color(m), ms=5,
                            label=f"{R.METHOD_LABEL[m]} L{L}")
        ax.axhline(0, ls="--", c="grey", lw=0.8); ax.set_xscale("log"); ax.set_xticks(lams)
        ax.set_xticklabels([f"{x:g}" for x in lams]); ax.set_title(R.DESIGN_LABEL.get(dn, dn), fontsize=9)
        ax.set_xlabel(r"$\lambda_0$"); ax.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
    axes[0][0].set_ylabel(r"median $\Delta$ELBO vs CAVI-cf (nats)", fontsize=9)
    axes[0][-1].legend(fontsize=7, frameon=False, loc="best")
    fig.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

Median $\Delta$ELBO vs CAVI-cf·Q2 (nats) and win rate, paired per sim; Q2 arms only. SER:

```{python}
#| label: tbl-elbo-ser
#| output: asis

```
